title: Gaussian Linear Functional Manifold Method for Massive Point Cloud Data
abstract: arXiv:2609.05744v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reconstructing continuous terrain manifolds from massive, unstructured airborne LiDAR point clouds remains challenging in complex Wildland-Urban Interface (WUI) environments, where deep neural networks require costly point-wise annotations and nonparametric surface reconstruction methods often lack structural interpretability. This paper introduces the Gaussian Linear Functional Manifold (GLFM), a physics-informed statistical framework that represents continuous surface topography using deterministic linear functional bases while modeling microscale diffuse laser backscatter as an isotropic Gaussian process. To avoid the quadratic computational cost of exact constrained maximum likelihood estimation, we develop an algebraic singular value decomposition (SVD) rank-reduction algorithm that enables linear-time parameter estimation and closed-form quadric classification. translated_title: 面向海量点云数据的高斯线性泛函流形方法
translated_abstract: 从海量、非结构化的机载激光雷达（LiDAR）点云中重建连续地形流形，在复杂的城乡交错带（WUI）环境中仍然具有挑战性，因为深度神经网络需要代价高昂的逐点标注，而非参数曲面重建方法往往缺乏结构可解释性。本文提出了高斯线性泛函流形（GLFM），这是一种基于物理信息的统计框架，利用确定性线性泛函基表示连续的地形表面，同时将微观尺度的激光漫反射后向散射建模为各向同性高斯过程。为了避免精确约束极大似然估计的二次方计算成本，我们开发了一种代数奇异值分解（SVD）降秩算法，实现了线性时间的参数估计和闭式二次曲面分类。在35.2平方公里的真实机载激光雷达数据上的评估表明，GLFM能够自动……
tldr: 提出高斯线性泛函流形（GLFM）物理信息统计框架，结合SVD降秩算法实现线性时间参数估计，解决了复杂城乡交错带环境中海量机载LiDAR点云的连续地形重建难题，兼具结构可解释性与无需逐点标注的优势。
en_tdlr: GLFM, a physics-informed statistical framework with an algebraic SVD rank-reduction algorithm enabling linear-time parameter estimation, tackles continuous terrain manifold reconstruction from massive airborne LiDAR point clouds in complex Wildland-Urban Interface environments without costly point-wise annotations.
